name: methyl-CpG binding domain 4, DNA glycosylase

function.text: MBD4 encodes methyl-CpG-binding domain protein 4. Annotated molecular activities include DNA N-glycosylase activity and DNA endonuclease activity. It participates in DNA repair and depyrimidination.

function.text: MBD4 encodes methyl-CpG-binding domain protein 4. It has thymine glycosylase activity and is specific for G:T mismatches within methylated and unmethylated CpG sites. It can also remove uracil or 5-fluorouracil in G:U mismatches. It was first identified as methyl-CpG-binding protein.
